hysterectomy-cost-india.question: What are the main risks?

mtp-treatment-india.question: What is the legal gestational limit for MTP in India?
mtp-treatment-india.answer: Under the MTP Act as amended in 2021: up to 20 weeks with one registered medical practitioner’s opinion; above 20 and up to 24 weeks with two practitioners’ opinions for Rule 3B categories (and as interpreted by the Supreme Court for unmarried women facing changed circumstances); beyond 24 weeks where a Medical Board diagnoses substantial fetal abnormalities necessitating termination. Confirm current details with the treating hospital and counsel.

mtp-treatment-india.question: Is the process confidential?
mtp-treatment-india.answer: Yes. The Act protects confidentiality of the woman’s particulars except as authorised by law. Our coordination treats enquiries as confidential patient information.

mtp-treatment-india.question: What documents or reports do I need?
mtp-treatment-india.answer: Passport/ID, gestational dating ultrasound, relevant labs, and prior obstetric records. Hospitals complete required MTP opinion and consent forms.

mtp-treatment-india.question: What are the risks and how are they managed?
mtp-treatment-india.answer: Incomplete abortion, bleeding, infection, uterine injury (surgical methods), anaesthesia risks, and emotional distress. Screening, sterile technique, monitoring, and clear warning-sign education mitigate risk.

mtp-treatment-india.question: Is counselling available before and after?
mtp-treatment-india.answer: Yes — pre- and post-procedure counselling can be arranged through the hospital team, with optional private video discussion before travel when appropriate.

mtp-treatment-india.question: How soon can I travel after the procedure?
mtp-treatment-india.answer: Fit-to-fly depends on method, gestation, and recovery. Many early cases need short observation plus buffer days; only the treating doctor clears flights.

infertility-treatment-india.question: What is the first step for infertility treatment in India?
infertility-treatment-india.answer: A complete evaluation: semen analysis, ovarian reserve/ovulation assessment, and tubal/uterine evaluation — then a written stepwise plan.

infertility-treatment-india.question: How much should I budget?
infertility-treatment-india.answer: Diagnostics first (often hundreds to low thousands USD), then IUI or IVF tiers. Surgery adds separate quotes when needed.

infertility-treatment-india.question: Should I start with IVF immediately?
infertility-treatment-india.answer: Not always. Age, duration of infertility, and test results decide. Jumping to IVF without a work-up can miss fixable factors — delaying IVF when clearly indicated also costs time.

infertility-treatment-india.question: Can fibroids or endometriosis be treated in the same trip?
infertility-treatment-india.answer: Sometimes. Sequencing should be agreed by surgical and fertility teams before you fly.

infertility-treatment-india.question: What reports should I upload?
infertility-treatment-india.answer: Prior labs, semen analysis, ultrasound/HSG, operative notes, and medication list.

infertility-treatment-india.question: How long does evaluation take?
infertility-treatment-india.answer: Some tests align with menstrual timing; compressed plans are possible with longer stays. Ask for a calendar.

infertility-treatment-india.question: Do you treat male infertility too?

egg-freezing-india.question: What is the cost of egg freezing in India?
egg-freezing-india.answer: Freeze-cycle packages often land in the low-to-mid thousands of USD before storage and future IVF. Always separate those line items.

egg-freezing-india.question: What age is best for egg freezing?
egg-freezing-india.answer: Younger ages generally yield better later odds, but decisions are personal after counselling on probabilities — not social media averages.

egg-freezing-india.question: How many eggs should I freeze?
egg-freezing-india.answer: Targets depend on age and goals; clinics counsel using expected euploid probabilities. One cycle may not meet the target.

egg-freezing-india.question: How long can eggs be stored?
egg-freezing-india.answer: Contract terms vary. Read duration, fees, and continuity clauses carefully as a cross-border patient.

egg-freezing-india.question: What are the medical risks?
egg-freezing-india.answer: Stimulation and retrieval risks similar to IVF, including OHSS in higher-risk responses.

egg-freezing-india.question: Is egg freezing the same as embryo freezing?
egg-freezing-india.answer: No. Eggs are frozen before fertilisation; embryos require sperm and different consents.

egg-freezing-india.question: Can I use frozen eggs in another country later?
egg-freezing-india.answer: Sometimes, with shipping/regulatory hurdles. Plan the intended thaw clinic early.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: What causes heavy or irregular periods?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: Hormonal imbalance, PCOS, fibroids, adenomyosis, bleeding disorders, thyroid disease, medications, and structural lesions — diagnosis guides therapy.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: When is post-menopausal bleeding urgent?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: Always evaluate promptly to exclude malignancy. Do not treat it as a routine elective package without diagnostics.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: What will my India evaluation include?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: Typically history, exam, ultrasound, labs, and hysteroscopy/biopsy when indicated.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: What medical treatments are used?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: Options may include antifibrinolytics, hormonal therapies, and LNG-IUS where appropriate — personalised after assessment.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: When is surgery needed?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: When structural disease (for example fibroids) drives symptoms, or when medical therapy fails and histology is clear.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: How much does care cost?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: Diagnostic packages differ from surgical packages. Match the quote to the pathway after triage.

menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.question: Can anaemia be corrected before travel home?
menstrual-disorders-treatment-india.answer: Yes — iron therapy or other measures may be part of the plan; confirm before flying.

cosmetic-gynecology-india.question: Who should avoid rushing into surgery?
cosmetic-gynecology-india.answer: Anyone under coercion, with untreated body-image distress, or with primary pain/prolapse issues better served by other pathways. Specialists should be willing to decline.

cosmetic-gynecology-india.question: What are the main risks?
cosmetic-gynecology-india.answer: Bleeding, infection, scarring, asymmetry, sensation change, and dissatisfaction requiring revision.

cosmetic-gynecology-india.question: How long is recovery?

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: What does vaginal rejuvenation mean clinically?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: It is an umbrella for surgical tightening/repair and some energy-based treatments. Examination decides what, if anything, is appropriate.

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: Is laser rejuvenation the same as surgery?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: No. Evidence, downtime, and indications differ. Be wary of one-size device packages.

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: Could physiotherapy help instead?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: Often yes for pelvic-floor issues. Good clinicians discuss non-surgical options first when relevant.

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: What are the risks?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: Pain, infection, scarring, dyspareunia, unmet expectations, and rare injury depending on method.

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: How long before I can fly or resume intercourse?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: Device sessions often have short downtime; surgical repair needs longer. Follow surgeon-specific clearance.

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: Is this confidential?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: Yes — private form/email pathways are preferred for sensitive enquiries.

vaginal-rejuvenation-india.question: How is this different from cosmetic gynecology?
vaginal-rejuvenation-india.answer: overlapping topics; rejuvenation often emphasises functional laxity/atrophy symptoms, while cosmetic pages emphasise aesthetic soft-tissue procedures. Many patients need both counselled together.
